rowActions.duplicatedBody: The copy starts as a draft — the original stage, dates and offer stay behind.

rowActions.deletedBody: Reminders, files and saved postings filed under it were kept, unlinked.
rowActions.confirmBody: The application and its note go. Anything filed under it — reminders, files, saved postings — is kept but unlinked.

offer.title: Offer
offer.acceptBody: {{name}} moves to closed, with the outcome recorded as accepted. The offer details and every reminder on it are kept.
offer.declineBody: {{name}} moves to closed, with the outcome recorded as declined. Nothing is deleted — the offer details and its reminders stay where they are.

stageDialog.title: Move to {{stage}}
stageDialog.nothingElse: Nothing else on the record changed.

transition.addToTimelineHint: Creates an interview entry on that date, with a reminder.
transition.addDeadline: Add the deadline to the timeline

transition.keepOfferHint: Respond by {{date}}. Turn this off to clear them.
transition.keepOfferHintComp: Respond by {{date}} · {{comp}}. Turn this off to clear them.

fields.deadlineHint: Puts a dated reminder on the calendar.

fields.confirmationRefHint: The reference the employer's portal gave you when you submitted.
fields.notePlaceholder: What still has to happen before this goes out.

validation.org: Name the employer — it is what the record is filed under.
validation.role: Name the role, so two applications to the same place stay apart.
validation.roleTag: Pick a role tag — the role filter and the charts read it.
validation.url: That is not a link a browser can open — include https://.
validation.deadline: Use a date in the form 2026-11-01.
validation.refusalFallback: Something about that record did not fit.

writes.noDeadline: No deadline yet — add one and it shows up in This week.
writes.postingFiled: The posting is filed under it.
writes.deadlineOff: {{name}} — its deadline is off the calendar.

dialog.noRecord: This dialog was opened without a record to edit
dialog.draftDiscardedBody: Nothing was added. Undo brings the form back as you left it.
dialog.changesDiscardedBody: {{name}} is unchanged. Undo brings your edits back.
dialog.changesDiscardedBodyNoName: The record is unchanged. Undo brings your edits back.
dialog.confirmDescription: Nothing is saved yet. Compare the two, then decide.
dialog.editDescription: Changes replace the current details, and the deadline moves with them.
dialog.guessedTaggedDescription: Prefilled from what you pasted — check the employer, role and keywords before saving.
dialog.guessedDescription: Prefilled from what you pasted — check the employer and role before saving.
dialog.createDescription: Track a job you are applying for. Starred fields are required.
dialog.duplicateWarning: {{message}} <anchor>Open the one you have</anchor>, or carry on and add this as a second record.

stageDates.datedBody: {{name}} — this is the day the record says it reached {{stage}}.
stageDates.undatedBody: {{name}} — the stage is still on the record; only its date is gone.
stageDates.title: Stage dates
stageDates.explain: Moving this application to another stage dates it automatically. Anything it reached before today can be filled in here.

note.droppedTitle: Note saved, with some formatting dropped
note.droppedOverflow: This note carries more formatting than jojo stores; the rest was kept as plain text.

note.title: Note

filed.title: From the Vault
filed.emptyBody: Documents, links and snippets can each be filed under as many jobs as they went to. File one under this job — from its row menu in the Vault — and it shows up here.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.noPosting: There is no saved posting behind this application, so jojo cannot read what it asks you to send. You can still add your own steps.
checklist.noModel: Drafting a checklist needs a model. Connect one in Settings, or add your own steps below.
checklist.ask: Ask jojo to read the posting for what you have to send, or add your own steps below.

fit.title: How you fit
fit.clearedBody: jojo will not read this posting again unless you ask it to.
fit.noPosting: There is no saved posting behind this application, so there is nothing to weigh you against. Capture the listing with the extension, or add the application from its link, and this fills in.
fit.noModel: Reading what a posting asks for needs a model. <anchor>Connect one in Settings</anchor>.
fit.noBackground: jojo has not read anything about your background yet, so it cannot weigh this posting against it. Put your CV in the Vault and say yes when it offers to read it.
fit.clearedNote: You cleared this reading, so jojo is leaving this posting alone.

people.addedBody: Their details can be filled in from the Vault.
people.takenOffBody: They are still in the Vault, and on their other applications.
people.title: People
people.emptyBody: Name the people writing your letters and the people you deal with there. Recommenders show up on the list you can send them from the Vault.
people.searchPlaceholder: Search people, or type a new name…
people.noMatch: Nobody else in the Vault matches that.

tailored.title: Tailored materials
tailored.chooserIntro: Rewritten for this posting, with the changes marked. Takes a minute or two on a local model.
tailored.noPosting: There is no saved posting behind this application, so there is nothing to tailor your documents for. Add the application from its link, or capture the listing, and this offers to.
tailored.noModel: Tailoring a document needs a model. <anchor>Connect one in Settings</anchor>.
tailored.noDocuments: Nothing to tailor yet. Tailoring rewrites the documents you send with an application — add your CV, statements or a cover letter on <profile>your profile</profile>, or file them in <vault>the Vault</vault> under Applications, and they appear here.
tailored.emptyResults: Nothing tailored yet. Choose a document above and jojo writes a version for this posting, with what it changed marked.
tailored.deletedBody: Gone from this application and from the Vault.

fromLink.savedByExtension: The extension saved the page to the Vault and it is filed under the application when you save it.
fromLink.savedFile: {{name}} is in the Vault and it is filed under the application when you save it.
fromLink.missing_one: {{count}} field was not on the page.
fromLink.missing_other: {{count}} fields were not on the page.
fromLink.check: Check the form before saving it.
fromLink.title: New application from a link
fromLink.description: The model reads the posting and fills the form in, and ticks any of your own keywords the job is plainly about. The page is kept in the Vault under Job postings — saved by the jojo extension when it is installed — and filed under the application once you save it. Nothing is saved as an application until you say so.
